source.author: verg
source.text: Est mollis flamma medullas interea, et tacitum vivit sub pectore volnus.
source.text_original: Est mollis flamma medullas / interea, et tacitum vivit sub pectore volnus.
source.text_english: Meanwhile a soft flame is within his marrow, and the silent wound lives under his breast.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: haec semper uiuit in pectore; ob hanc Nepotianus noster absens praesens est et per tanta terrarum spatia diuisos utraque complectitur manu.
reuse.text_original: haec semper uiuit in pectore; ob hanc Nepotianus noster absens praesens est et per tanta terrarum spatia diuisos utraque complectitur manu.
reuse.text_english: This always lives in my heart; for her Nepotian, though absent, is present, and across such vast stretches of land, though separated, he embraces both with either hand.
